controlPlaneNotes: No public agent/* RPC and no graph/store RPC exists in the generated ClientRequest schema (full enumeration in no-agent-rpc.txt; store wiring negative evidence in store-negative-evidence.txt).

Per-subagent interrupt from an external client is not directly exposed; outer orchestrator cancels the whole leader turn via turn/interrupt (runtime proof: interrupt-cross-evidence.json, P0-6 trace C, PR #108: sleep child present before interrupt, absent after) or asks the leader to use interrupt_agent.

Resume evaluation (static code assessment, not a runtime trace): thread/resume (app-server/src/request_processors/thread_processor.rs:640 -> thread_resume_inner:3925) cold-resumes any persisted thread, including a child agent thread, as an INDEPENDENT top-level session; it does not re-attach the child to a running leader's agent tree. In-tree single-agent resume is the leader's resume_agent tool (MAv1 only; MAv2 exposes no resume tool). External in-tree per-agent resume would be an F-1-shaped addition; not required for the orchestrator MVP (leader-mediated resume suffices).

Topology is reconstructed from SubAgentActivity items (kind started/interacted/interrupted/completed) + CollabAgentToolCall.agentsStates (per-agent threadId) + child-thread thread/read. thread/list does NOT enumerate agent threads: probes['thread/list'].agentThreadsListed is empty.
Child thread history readable via thread/read when agentThreadId is known (see probes). thread/items/list is UNSUPPORTED_SERVER_SIDE (P0-9 probe); leader history comes from rollout files.
Hook events SubagentStart/SubagentStop exist in the protocol (hooks-events.txt, static existence only; runtime hook firing not traced in this spike).
